title: Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans: Premium Collection, Cancellation and Renewal Schedule
content:
How the premium on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans is collected, the windows and fees that attach to giving the plan up, and whether and when it may be renewed are fixed per plan in this schedule kept by plan administration.

| | Manufacturer Limited Warranty | Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| How the premium is collected | single payment | single payment | single payment | single payment | monthly | monthly |
| Calendar days a monthly premium may be late before coverage is at risk | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 | 15 |
| Calendar days of unpaid premium after which coverage is suspended | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 45 | 60 |
| Full-refund window, calendar days after purchase | 0 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 90 |
| Premium returned in proportion to the unused term after the full-refund window | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Administration fee deducted from a prorated premium refund | 0.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 35.00 USD | 50.00 USD | 75.00 USD |
| Coverage may be renewed at the end of its term | no | yes | yes | yes | no | no |
| Renewal window, calendar days before expiry | 0 | 60 | 60 | 90 | 0 | 0 |
| Increase applied to the premium on renewal | 0.0 percent | 12.0 percent | 10.0 percent | 8.0 percent | 0.0 percent | 0.0 percent |

## Notes on the schedule

- Only the Belrose Lifetime Care Plan and the Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan collect the premium monthly, and only on those two plans do the late grace (10 and 15 calendar days) and the suspension threshold (45 and 60 calendar days of unpaid premium) have any figure at all.
- The Manufacturer Limited Warranty has a full-refund window of 0 days, does not prorate and carries no administration fee, consistent with its premium being nothing.
- The three renewable plans are the 2-Year, 3-Year and 5-Year Belrose Care Plans; their renewal windows are 60, 60 and 90 calendar days before expiry and their renewal uplifts 12.0, 10.0 and 8.0 percent.
